notes: The service fee of 500 € per semester applies to non-EU students in English-language programmes including International Engineering, starting from winter semester 2025/2026; it is charged in addition to the semester fee (115 €). The university does not charge general tuition fees ('keine Studiengebühren'). The application channel for foreign-diploma applicants is uni-assist VPD: the diploma must first be reviewed by uni-assist, which issues a Vorprüfungsdokumentation (VPD). The DAAD page gives application deadlines for winter semesters 2026 and 2027; the university's own Bachelor application page gives general dates (summer semester 2027: 15 November 2026 to 15 January 2027; winter semester 2027/2028: mid-April 2027 to 15 July 2027). The VPD processing time is approximately 6 weeks. German language skills A1 are required but proof can be submitted later (by the end of the first semester), so it is a manual check, not a hard requirement at application. The English B1 certificate is required but can be submitted later (by 30 September for winter semester, 14 March for summer semester).
